answer: Reaching eligibility takes 71 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The nebula register is checked at draw time, wander lists the eligible set, and crystal seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 71 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 324 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
